## Source Messages

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />101 - Source assignment changed (meter)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00000">

Changing the meter that is assigned to a source on a source assignment will cause this message to be generated.

- Message Text: Source assignment changed (meter)
- Data 1 Usage: Meter Number
- Data 2 Usage: Effective Date
- Data 3 Usage: Old Value
- Data 4 Usage: New Value
- Message Class: Security
- Message Priority: 5

</div>
